clusterUrl.description: URL of the cluster endpoint. If provided, this will be used instead of fetching the cluster URL dynamically.

dnsBypassCheckV2.description: Enable DNS bypass detection. Set to 1 to enable, 0 to disable. If not set and clusterUrl is configured, defaults to enabled.

chromebookOnly.description: When set to 1, filtering applies only on Chrome OS devices. On Windows, Mac, and Linux, clusterUrl is set to AVOID_OS so filtering is disabled. Set to 0 to disable.
